rules.title: Window days validation
rules.statement: Raise LMS-031 exception if p_window_days is null or outside 1-90 inclusive.
rules.notes: Declared parameter is int with no precision shown.

rules.title: Skip NPA loans
rules.statement: Increment p_skipped and skip any loan where asset_class = 'NPA'.

rules.title: Require benchmark code
rules.statement: Raise LMS-005 exception for any floating loan with benchmark_code null.

rules.title: Next reset date calculation
rules.statement: Compute v_months as completed reset cycles since disb_date then add one reset_months interval to obtain v_next; skip loan if v_next > p_as_of + p_window_days.
rules.notes: Uses extract(year/month from age) with integer division; no rounding call.

rules.title: Notice date weekday adjustment
rules.statement: Set v_notice to v_next plus 2 days if Saturday or 1 day if Sunday, otherwise v_next.

rules.title: New rate lookup
rules.statement: v_new = (latest benchmark_rate.rate_pct where effective_date <= v_next) + coalesce(spread_pct, 0); missing benchmark yields 0.
rules.notes: coalesce to 0 for missing benchmark value; numeric with no declared precision.

rules.title: Old rate lookup
rules.statement: v_old = (latest benchmark_rate.rate_pct where effective_date <= prior cycle start) + coalesce(spread_pct, 0); missing benchmark yields 0.
rules.notes: coalesce to 0 for missing benchmark value; numeric with no declared precision.

rules.title: Skip small rate change or duplicate notice
rules.statement: Increment p_skipped and skip if abs(v_new - v_old) < 0.25 or a RESET_NOTICE entry already exists with note containing the v_next date.
rules.notes: Uses LIKE pattern on note; no rounding call.

rules.title: Insert reset notice
rules.statement: Insert loan_ledger row with entry_type RESET_NOTICE, amount = v_new, note containing reset date and old/new rates; increment p_posted.
rules.notes: amount stored as numeric v_new with no declared precision.

open_questions: Confirm that missing benchmark rates are intentionally treated as 0 rather than error.
Confirm that numeric rate values are stored without explicit scale/precision or rounding.
Confirm that duplicate check relies only on note text pattern match.
